dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.role: Moetapele wa Bopaki ba Khomishene • DPCI Hawks
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Rea u amohela Khomisheneng ea Lipatlisiso, Sbu. Berth 14 e senotse tsohle tse neng li etsahala koung, kahoo joale mokhatlo ona o re loantša ka babuelli ba molao ba apereng silika le litaelo tsa ho thibela ho bua tse tsoang ho State Security."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Se mpe le ho feta, re thibetse telemetry ea moralo oa sefofane ho tsoa King Shaka International. Sefofane ZS-900—Gulfstream ea poraefete—e ntse e tšeloa mafura Hangar 7 ho ntša Zuko, Ma-Sibi, le Mokoena ho ba isa Dubai."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Lipontšo tse peli tse kholo: Tsa pele, Tumellano ea Trust ea Sovereign Pearl Offshore ho tsoa Ridge Penthouses e phelang hore bobeli ba bona ke beng ba mokhatlo ona. Tsa bobeli, Telemetry ea Batch ea Midlands Super-Lab ho tsoa literakeng tsa metsi tsa leboea."
"Bula e 'ngoe ea liphiri tsena ho senola Citrus Estate le King Shaka Hangar 7—kapa u sireletse tseo ka bobeli haeba u batla ho kenya e mong le e mong oa bona litlamong holim'a tarmac."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Qotso e ntle ea molao, Sbu. Seo se tlama matsoho a babuelli ba molao ba Ma-Sibi ba senyehileng ka lihora tse ling tse mashome a mane a metso e robeli mme se qobella mongoli oa Ridge ho bula buka ea DIFC."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "U latetse literaka tsa metsi ho fihlela holimo thabeng, Sbu. Hoa hlolla. Banna ba bangata ba emisa hang ha ba fihla li-penthouse tsa lebopong la leoatle Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Sheba ho potoloha Packhouse B. Li-orange tsa Valencia li le holim'a conveyor, crystal e hloekileng ka liperesente tse mashome a robong a metso e robong ka har'a mabokose a bohata ka tlase, e lebisitsoe ka kotloloho ho King Shaka Cargo Apron. Mme u eme bohareng ba kotulo ea ka."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Ke tšohile? Che, Sbu—ke hlophisa bocha. Khomishene ea Lipatlisiso e hloka sesomo, kahoo Ma-Sibi le Mokoena ba tšohile. Ho sa le joalo, lisebelisoa tseo re li hahileng mona li hatisa limilione tse mashome a mabeli tsa Euro ka khoeli."

"Ha u fihla Hangar 7 bosiung bona, u tla ba le khetho: re tšoere bakeng sa naha e tla re nkela sebaka ka Labobeli, u chese setša sena le sehlopha sa Bra Bheki, kapa u itšoarele linotlolo tsa terone uena."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Batho ba thunyang ba Gauteng baa ikhula. U iphumanetse setulo tafoleng, Sbu. Nka sena ho tsoa polokelong ea packhouse—mme u nahane ka hloko pele u lumella Colonel van der Merwe ho kenya bokamoso litlamong."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Motho ea balehang molao? Ka liperesente tse mashome a mabeli a metso e mehlano tsa Sovereign Pearl Holdings ka har'a vault ea Dubai, ba tla mpitsa moeletsi oa ts'ireletso ea machaba! Ebang u tlohe tseleng ea lebili la sefofane, kapa u etse qeto ea hau ea ho qetela mona!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Unit 3 le Unit 5 li ea kae?! Molato oa hau, Sbu—u fetotse li-sergeant tsa ka khahlanong le rona! E mong le e mong a itširele ho tarmac!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "Qetellong ea tsela ea ho fofela, Sbu! Lienjine tsa Gulfstream li futhumetse, tumello ea boemeli e kentsoe, mme li-pallet jacks li ntse li kenya mabokose a ho qetela ka har'a sefofane."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "U pholohile N2, u pholohile Pier 2, mme u pholohile sehlopha sa ka sa polao. Bua taba ea hau pele litepisi tsa ho palama li hula!"
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Likoloi tse peli tse nang le mabone a maputsoa li re thibetse ka mor'a Umgeni off-ramp. Brigadier Mokoena o ne a bile a sa roala mask. O ile a tsoa a apere junifomo ea hae ea TRT, a sheba mokotla oa Sithole, a bolella corporal oa hae hore a chese koloi."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ke ile ka thella ka moepa ho kena ka har'a mohohlo oa pula ke tšoere foldara ea mantlha tlas'a hempe ea ka. Haeba Sparks oa Golden Dragon a ka petola mohala oa Sithole, lentsoe la Mokoena le ho lona."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Sheba—lipoleiti ND-449-102 ho isa ho 118. Ba qositse City Hall liranta tse mashome a mane a metso e 'meli ho isa metsi a nooang KwaMashu nakong ea komello, empa sheba li-toll tag tsa diesel. Ha baa ka ba leba leboea le hang."
"Teraka e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e khannetse ka kotloloho Pier 2 Cold Storage ka 01:30 hoseng. Ba tsamaisa lik'hemik'hale tsa Zuko Ndlovu tlas'a lebitso la metsi a masepala."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... mashome a tšeletseng lekholong Abasanta Maritime, mashome a mane lekholong trust ea lelapa la Ma-Sibi. U e fumane, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "E ise ho Colonel van der Merwe ka Old Archive Basement—kapa u chese Berth 14 uena ka bouena. Leha ho le joalo, ba ke ke ba phonyoha."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.role: Mosenodi ea Lemetseng • Paki ea Bohlokoa
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "Se ke oa bula likharetene, Sbu. Li-Golf GTI tse se nang matšoao tsa Mokoena li potoloha Anton Lembede Street metsotso e meng le e meng e mashome a mabeli. Ha baa ka ba bolaea Auditor Sithole feela ho Umgeni weighbridge—ba ne ba mo emetse ba se ba hlakotse li-transponder tsa boema-kepe."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Tsohle tseo Sithole a shoetseng tsona li ka har'a Docket #409 le mohala oo o robehileng. Mpolelle hore re ke ke ra shoela ka folete ena bosiung bona."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Mookameli oa Tekisi ea Queen Street • Motsamaisi oa Syndicate
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, ex-Hawk o kena Queen Street ha bashanyana ba TRT ba Mokoena ba ntse ba hlahloba tekisi e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe Warwick Junction. U na le sebete, Sbu, kea u lumela."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "Ha ho letho le tsamaeang ka CBD ntle le hore bakhanni ba ka ba le bone—eseng li-Nyalas tsa SAPS, 'me haholo-holo eseng literaka tseo tsa metsi tse tsamaeang ka boima ka bobeli hoseng."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "Ha u so lebale hore na seterateng ho sebetsa joang, Sbu. Ho entsoe. Li-Quantum tsa ka tse tharo li thibetse koloi ea khamera ea SAPS ho Monty Naicker Road. U na le sebaka sa ho hema."
"Nka sena ho tsoa letloleng la ntoa. Reka diesel, u fe mookameli tjotjo, kapa u phekole Nandi. Etsa bonnete ba hore Mokoena oa tsoa mali ka ho thibela literata tsa rona."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Mamela hantle. Literaka tseo li na le li-sticker tsa City Hall mamating, na? Empa bashanyana ba ka ba sebetsang bosiu ba Umbilo ba re mabili a khumame tlas'a boima ba meropa ea lik'hemik'hale, 'me ba-thunya ba Abasanta ba lutse ka Golf R."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "Ha re ntse re le joalo, bo-'m'a rona KwaMashu ba eme moleng ka linkho tsa polasetiki. Councillor Ma-Sibi o rekisa batho ba habo."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Kahoo Hawk ea nang le litoro o qetelle a ithutile theko ea nama eThekwini. Nka chelete ena e nkuoeng ho locker. Boloka faele eo ea molumo e le sieo tafoleng ea Colonel van der Merwe, mohlomong Zuko a ka u tlohela u phele ho fihlela bekeng e tlang."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Hlakola Car 4 le Car 7 ho tsoa karolong ea Victoria Embankment. Kamehla u ne u tseba ho bapala chess ea bo-ralipolotiki, Sbu. Natefeloa ke lihora tse mashome a mabeli a metso e mene tse eketsehileng—li ke ke tsa u pholosa ha Berth 14 e hloekisoa."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "Durban e tsamaisoa ke taolo, Sbu. Zuko o boloka likou li khutsitse, Ma-Sibi o boloka mabone a tuka City Hall, 'me Task Force ea ka e boloka khotso. Mandla Sithole o ne a nahana hore spreadsheet e ka emisa terene."
"Nehelana ka Nandi pele ho har'a bosiu ka Letsatsi la 4, kapa banna ba ka ba ke ke ba itšoenya ka ho kokota monyako oa hau oa Mercury Arcade."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.role: Molaodi oa SAPS TRT • Mohlankana oa Cartel
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Hee-hee. Bona se tlisitsoeng ke pula ofising ea ka. U emisitsoe mosebetsing ho Hawks, Sbu—ho kena mona ho hloka hore ebe u batla ho shoa kapa u na le 'muelli oa molao ea turang haholo."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Constable Nandi o kae, 'me briefcase ea mohlahlobi oa lichelete oa masepala e kae?"
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Basebetsi ba nang le bokhoni ba thata ho fumaneha masepaleng ona. Ho lokile—nka pampiri ea litsela tsa telecoms. U tla fumana hore e lebisa toka ho crane ea Zuko ho Berth 14."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Load shedding ke tlokotsi, Sbu—ntle le haeba u tseba hore na ke breaker efe eo u ka e hulang le neng. Ha Stage 6 e otla Point Waterfront, lik'hamera tsa Transnet li tima ka lihora tse nne."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Metsoalle ea City Hall ha e lule lefifing. Lira li fumana matlo a tsona a hlaseloa pele mabone a seterateng a khutla."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "Mandla Sithole e ne e le mohlahlobi oa lichelete ea bohlale ea se nang boikemisetso ba ho phela. Uena, ka lehlakoreng le leng, u utloisisa matla a ho hatella."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Ke ena chelete ea R500 e tsoang ho letlole la ward. Boloka lebitso la trust ea ka le le sieo likoranteng, 'me ofisi ea ka e ka ba ea laola grid ea Eskom ha u hloka hore motlakase o time."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "U ntse u batlisisa Procurement Registry B. Mpolelle hore na mofuputsi ea hlabisitsoeng lihlong o batla eng ka lisebelisoa tsa metsi a tšohanyetso."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "O ntse o hlahloba Procurement Registry B. Mphe tsebo, mofuputsi ya hlabisitseng dihlong o batlang ka meralo ya metsi ya tshohanyetso?"
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "E, Central Precinct e ne e na le tora ea stingray e hoketsoeng ho SIM ea hau ea khale. Ke fetotse baseband MAC address ea hau hore e shebahale joaloka parking meter ea masepala. Noa!"
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "Sithole e ne e se mohlahlobi oa lichelete feela—o ile a beha maekrofono Pier 2 Cold Storage. Pele ba thula koloi ea hae ho N2, mohala oa hae o ile oa boloka lentsoe la metsotsoana e mashome a mane a metso e robeli le manifest ea container bakeng sa MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Empa hlokomela Stage 6. Ntle le haeba u sebelisa jenereithara ea diesel, mochini oa ka oa ho hlakola o tla tima."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Hlokomela terata ea ho thibela haufi le setulo sa litente, Sbu! Li-spike tsa motlakase tsa Stage 4 li sa tsoa chesa li-oscilloscope tsa ka tse peli, 'me batho ba Mokoena ba cyber-crime ba ntse ba hlahloba tora e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea mehala pakeng tsa Grey Street le kou."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "U ntliselitse GraphemeOS brick ea Mandla Sithole? Mohala oo o na le Abasanta remote-wipe daemon ho baseband chip."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Bona nako ea motlakase—re fetile senotlolo sa pele sa biometric ntle le ho tsosa Abasanta wipe daemon. Pase e le 'ngoe hape tafoleng 'me drive ena ke ea hau."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Sheba koung, Sbu. Likepe tse mashome a tšeletseng li emetse, likontinara tse likete tse tharo ka letsatsi, 'me Pretoria e nahana hore pampiri e saennoeng ke magistrate e laola kou ena."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ke hahile Abasanta Logistics ho tsoa ho shed e le 'ngoe ea polokelo ea serame. Hona joale u eme holim'a catwalk ea ka u tšoere buka ea mohlahlobi ea shoeleng. Na u tlile ho bapala hero, kapa u tlile ho utloisisa tlhoko le phepelo?"
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Motho ea bohlale. Hawks ba u lefile chelete e nyane 'me ba u lahletse ho liphiri ha u atamela haufi haholo le 'nete. Nka sena e le kabelo ea hau ea pele ho tsoa Berth 14. Ha har'a bosiu bo fihla, etsa bonnete ba hore convoy eo e tsamaea."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "Ha ho makatse hore ebe sehlopha sa Mokoena se u hlotsoe ho N2. U tsamaea joalo ka mosi oa boema-kepe. Bolella Titus hore ke hlakotse lintja tsa hae tsa patrol ea boema-kepe bosiung bona—haeba re tla lekana, a re ho etseng ntle le batho ba sa tsebeng mosebetsi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "City Hall e utsoitse tekanyetso ea metsi lilemo tse leshome pele nka hira tanker, Sbu. Ke mpa ke hiritse literaka tsa bona tse se nang letho. Naheng ena, lisebelisoa ke tsa mang kapa mang ea hlokomelang disele le ea lefang balebeli."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "Mokoena ke motho ea se nang bohlale, 'me Ma-Sibi ke parasite. Nthuse ho hloekisa Berth 14 bosiung bona, 'me u ke ke ua hlola u sokola bakeng sa rente ho Mercury Arcade."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "U fetile lik'hamera tsa lekhotla la magistrate, Sbu. Ho lokile. Halofo ea Provincial Headquarters e lefa Mokoena, ke ka lebaka leo ke isitseng task force ea ka mona ka tlase le mechini ea microfiche ea bo-1980."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "U shebahala hampe, ngoan'a ka—'me ke utloile hore Constable Nandi o fumane thunya ho N2. Mpolelle hore u tlisitse ntho e ka pholohang moahloli oa High Court."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Molimo oa ka... 'thibela sedan ea hae pele ho Umgeni off-ramp 'me u chese briefcase.' Ke lentsoe la Titus Mokoena, le utloahalang hantle."
"Ke beha koloi ea hau ho registry ea rona ea dipolomate hona joale ho hlakola Precinct Heat ea hau. Lula u phela ho fihlela re phatlalatsa sena, Sbu."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Hobane nako le nako ha ke ngola warrant Upstairs, motho e mong o tsebisa City Hall nakong ea metsotso e leshome le metso e mehlano. Ntle le ledger ea lichelete LE molumo oa Berth 14, mochochisi o tla lahla nyeoe pele ho lijo tsa hoseng."
"Haeba re romela sephutheloana sohle ho The Daily Veld newsroom ha re ntse re sireletsa Nandi, ba ke ke ba e pata."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "E nke. Tsepamisa khalefo ea hau ho super-lab ea Zuko Midlands kapa batho ba Mokoena—tlohela mosali ea tsofetseng a ee villa ea hae ea penshene Palm Jumeirah."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Politiki e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e bohlale KwaZulu-Natal e tseba hore Rand ke ea ho sebelisa 'me Dirham ke ea ho boloka. Sovereign Pearl e na le thepa Dubai, polasi ea litholoana Midlands, le sefofane sa charter Hangar 7."
"Zuko o na le karolo ea mashome a mane a metso e mehlano, ke na le mashome a mararo, 'me Titus Mokoena o na le mashome a mabeli a metso e mehlano bakeng sa ho boloka lithunya li le hole le rona."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "U hackile escrow terminal? U hlile u sa khathale. Ho lokile—bachochisi ba tšoereng Contempt Warrant khahlanong le uena ba mamela coalition whip ea ka. Ke tla ba bolella hore ba liehise faele ea hau ea ho tšoaroa."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Moea o hloekile mona holimo ho Ridge, na ha ho joalo, Sbu? Tlase ho CBD ba tšoere Judicial Commission of Inquiry ea bona, ba iketsa eka moahloli ea pensheneng a ka rarolla lilemo tse mashome a mabeli a bobolu ba masepala."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Li-suitcase tsa ka li se li le King Shaka Hangar 7. Ke hobane'ng ha u hloa tora ea ka ea khalase ha sefefo se se se le haufi le ho fela?"
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "E 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea tsona! Pakeng tsa 1:00 AM le 4:00 AM, ho fapana le ho pompa metsi ho tsoa polokelong, literaka tsena li hloetse N3 ho ea polasing ea litholoana haufi le Howick spur."
"Kopanya lintlha tseo tsa telemetry, Sbu, 'me u tla ba le li-coordinate tse nepahetseng tsa super-lab ea Zuko."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Mona ke flash module ho tsoa Tanker #14! 'Me u se ke oa tšoenyeha ka batho bao ba tlhaselo ba tsoang Joburg—sedan efe kapa efe e sa tloaelehang e kenang corridor ea leboea e tla koalloa ke li-Quantum tse mashome a mane pele ba ka kenya makasine."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Sheba litankara tsena tseo re li tšoereng bosiung bo fetileng, Sbu! Li-baffle tsa bohata li cheselitsoe ka hare ho meropa—li omme joaloka lesapo ka har'a karolo ea metsi, 'me ho na le masala a lik'hemik'hale ka har'a mantlha a patiloeng."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Batho ba libakeng tsa leboea ba khathetse ke ho emela likomishene tsa High Court. Bakhanni ba ka ba koetse depot, 'me izinkabi tsa Mokoena li ntse li batla uena litseleng tsa ridge."
dialogue.new_lead_title: Teko e ncha ea boemo kapa bopaki bo bocha bo teng!
dialogue.select_response: Kgetha Mola oa Lipotso / Karabo (Tšenyo ea 0 ea Litaele)
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Tšoara liheke tsa depot, Bra Bheki. Re ea loana le bona setšeng sa bona."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Na litankara tse tšoeroeng li ne li ntse li na le li-transponder tsa GPS tsa dash-mount?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "A re ntšeng li-chip tsa GPS ho Lead Tanker #14 hona joale 'me re behe balebeli ba baahi khahlanong le sehlopha sa tlhaselo."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Bakhanni ba hau ba bosiu ba reng ka literaka tsa metsi?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Tlhahisoleseding e ntle. A re bue ka ntho e 'ngoe."
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Boloka mabone a hau a le tlase, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Tlhompho, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Ke eona ntho e sieo pakeng tsa boema-kepe le boema-fofane."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Selekano sa Queen Street se eme hammoho. Na rank e ka mpha chelete ea ts'ebetso?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "E tla ea ka kotloloho ho senyeng sehlopha sa bona."
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Ba-hlahlobi ba hau ba nkolota ka lebaka la tumellano ea Berea. Hlakola lipoleiti tsa ka ho ba-hlahlobi ba Mokoena."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Karohano e ntle ea batho ba bararo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Present Evidence: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Ke na le lethathamo la beng ba thepa, Ma-Sibi. Reka setulo sa hau ho tsoa ho charge sheet ea ka."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "Se ke oa hloella Gulfstream eo hajoale, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "Sovereign Pearl Holdings ke eng, 'me ke hobane'ng ha Gulfstream e tletse peterole ho Hangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Mokhomishenara oa hau o lebetse ho hlakola Dubai SWIFT mirror ho seva sa 28th-floor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Ke hobane'ng ha Sub-Station 14 e lula e tima ha Pier 2 e laolla thepa har'a bosiu?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Mongoli oa hau o siile kemiso ea Sub-Station 14 mochineng oa fax. Ke kopitsa nako ea ho tima ha motlakase koung."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Natefeloa ke moea o pholileng ha o ntse o le teng, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Ke leboha haholo, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "Tlhophiso e loketseng."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "Ke tla nka chelete ena. Re tla bona ka likoranta."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "Re tla bona hore na ke mang ea fihlang sefofaneng."
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Mashome a mane a liphesente tsa Zululand Aqua-Logistics ke tsa trust ea lelapa la hau, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Mohato o bohlale."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_exit.label: "Ke nako ea ho qetella sena ho tarmac."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_influence.lab: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Halofo ea li-sergeant tsa hau tsa TRT ha li eo sefofaneng seo, Titus. Ke sa tsoa ba bolella hore u ba siea hore ba jare molato Khomisheneng."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_tarmac.label: "Haeba u hloa litepisi tseo, Titus, u tla ba motho ea balehang molao bophelo bohle ba hau."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "Ke mpa ke hlahloba lethathamo la litlolo tsa molao, Brigadier. Na u tšoenyehile ka ntho e itseng ho N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Robala hantle, Brigadier. Hlokomela moo u hatang teng ha motlakase o tima."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Internal Affairs e Pretoria e se e na le kopi ea Docket #409. Hlakola ts'ebetso ea hau kapa re tla cha ka bobeli."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_mutiny_back.label: "Tarmac e butsoe. A re feliseng sena."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Ke na le lentsoe la hau ho tape u laela tlhaselo ea Umgeni, Titus. Ntefe hore ke lahle kopi ena."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "Re tla bona hore na mokitlane oa hau o nka nako e kae."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_standdown_back.lab: "Ho monate ho etsa khoebo le taolo ea SAPS."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Tšoara mohopolo oo, Titus."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "Mphetisetse hape ka ho hlaseloa ha N2 weighbridge. Ke mang ea huletseng thunya?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "A re boeleng re hlahlobe likhetho tsa rona."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "Seo se mpholosa lihora tse ngata tsa ho hlahloba. Tšoara ka thata."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Sheba linako tsena tsa weighbridge le 'na. Ke lipoleiti life tsa teraka tse neng li le sieo?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_exit.label: "Phomola, Nandi. Koala monyako ka thata ha ke ntse ke sebetsa seterateng."
dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "Ke tla etsa bonnete ba hore lentsoe leo le utluoa ke bohle."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ledger_back.label: "Phomola. Re kena qetellong ea ntoa."
dialogue_resp.nandi_show_ledger.label: [Hlahisa Bopaki: Ledger ea Metsi e Hlalositsoeng] "Ke latetse k'hamphani ea bohata. Ma-Sibi le Zuko ke bona beng ba literaka."
dialogue_resp.sparks_ask_phone.label: "Ho na le eng mohaleng oa mohlahlobi eo e leng hore Zuko le Mokoena ba tšohile hakana?"
dialogue_resp.sparks_coffee_stim.label: [Pay R100] "Beha pitsa ea kofi ea Ethiopian holim'a stove 'me u hlahlobe burner phone ea ka bakeng sa li-IMSI-catcher tsa SAPS."
dialogue_resp.sparks_collab_back.label: "Ho tjheseletsa ho hantle, Sparks."
dialogue_resp.sparks_exit.label: "Boloka Faraday cage e koetsoe, Sparks."
dialogue_resp.sparks_imsi_back.label: "Ea natefela."

dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_present_telemetr: [Present Evidence: Super-Lab Telemetry] "Nomoro e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea batch le tsela ea teraka li se li ntse li kopilitsoe ka ntle. Emisa sehlopha sa hau sa izinkabi mme u lefe lekhetho la phetoho."

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: PHOLOSHO E FELILE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): O pholohile dikganyetso tsa motlakase, o pepesitse morero wa Sovereign Pearl, mme o tlisitse ba sa amehang ba eThekwini-Gold tokelong.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: As Gulfstream ZS-900 turns onto the active taxiway, four unmarked Hawks interceptors and a High Court sheriff’s van block the nose gear. You step out into the blinding sodium glare holding the certified Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed and the Midlands super-lab batch logs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: Brigadier Mokoena reaches for his holster, but seeing twenty DPCI rifles trained on the airstairs—and a live broadcast camera streaming directly to the Commission’s emergency feed—he slowly lowers his weapon. Councillor Ma-Sibi and Zuko Ndlovu are led down the wet stairs in steel cuffs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: By morning, the KwaZulu-Natal High Court places Zululand Aqua-Logistics under judicial administration, and the northern township reservoirs open to full pressure for the first time in a year.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Lekgetlo la pele ka dilemo tse mashome a mabedi, disirene tsa mabone a boputswa di ne di sa hlakole sephethephethe bakeng sa bo-VIP—di ne di ba tshwara ka diketane."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift1.summ: Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, and Brigadier Mokoena face 142 counts of racketeering, treasonous sabotage, and murder before a special High Court tribunal.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Forensic teams seize R1.2 billion in offshore escrow and dismantle the Howick hydroponic precursor plant.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift3.summ: Promoted to Major in the rebuilt DPCI Organised Crime Directorate, you and Constable Nandi take over the 13th Floor of Central Setheo sa Mapolesa.

ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: PHOLOSHO E FELILE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): O pshatlile mokgatlo wa mmuso o laolwang mme o kgutlisitse bophelo ba eThekwini-Gold ho batho ba yona.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Instead of waiting for slow court orders, you broadcast the Hangar 7 coordinates and the Sovereign Pearl escrow keys directly to Bra Bheki’s Queen Street marshals and the Northern Township strike committees.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Within thirty minutes, three hundred minibus taxis and forty hijacked municipal water tankers smash through the cargo apron perimeter fence, surrounding Gulfstream ZS-900 on the runway. Zuko’s mercenaries drop their rifles and flee into the sugarcane fields.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Before sunrise, the Mokgatlo wa Bosholu’s R400 million liquid escrow is wired directly into community water cooperatives, and a convoy of freshly flushed tankers rolls into KwaMashu with sirens blaring in celebration.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Ba utswitse metsi mme ba re rekisetsa komello. Bosiung bona re nkile ditereka, dipompo, le akhaonto ya banka."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: The Northern Township Water Forum seizes permanent control of the municipal tanker fleet, ending the artificial drought overnight.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Stripped of both their Sehlopha sa Ditlokotsebe protection and offshore slush funds, Ma-Sibi’s coalition resigns en masse amid citywide street celebrations.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift3.sum: Every minibus from Point Road to the Midlands carries your callsign on the rear window—the outlaw Hawk who gave the city back to its streets.

ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: PHOLOSHO E FELILE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): O hlodiile sehlopha se seng le se seng eThekwini-Gold mme wa iphumanela terone ya mmuso o moriti.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: You stand alone in the rain at Hangar 7 with your thumb on the encrypted broadcast switch. Zuko Ndlovu looks at the High Court subpoena in your left hand and the Dubai flight plan in your right, then smiles and signs the transfer of Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: At 00:05 AM, you call off the Hawks interceptors and watch Gulfstream ZS-900 climb into the storm clouds toward the Indian Ocean. Ten minutes later, Colonel van der Merwe receives a sanitized Tokomane ya Molato pinning the entire conspiracy on a dead deputy clerk.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: From the top floor of the Umhlanga Ridge glass tower, you watch Stage 6 plunge the city below into darkness—while your private turbines hum without a flicker.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Mmuso ha o we ha morena a palama sefofane. Ba mpa ba fetola ditshaene ho tokomane ya tshepo."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: With Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena exiled in Dubai, you assume 100% control of Sovereign Pearl Holdings, the Boema-kepe cranes, and the Midlands estate.
The State Capture Inquiry releases a toothless 900-page report recommending "administrative reforms" with zero high-profile convictions.
You own the judges, the taxi ranks, and the municipal tenders. In eThekwini-Gold, midnight now belongs to you.

ending.ending_act2_vanished.p1: Arriving at Hangar 7 without certified proof of either the Sovereign Pearl trust or the Midlands batch telemetry leaves you exposed on the open tarmac. When Stage 6 cuts the airport perimeter lights, Brigadier Mokoena’s sniper team pins your vehicle behind a cargo loader.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p2: Gulfstream ZS-900 roars down the runway and lifts into the coastal clouds carrying every original Buka ya Ditjhelete and witness out of South African jurisdiction.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p3: Three weeks later, the Commission of Inquiry closes its proceedings behind locked doors, sealing your uncorroborated testimony in the National Archives for fifty years.

When the grid drops to Stage 6, the streetlights die—and four unmarked TRT Volkswagen Golfs box you against the shuttered roller doors.

ending.ending_kingpin.p1: The private elevator to The Glass House rises above the rusted container cranes into air-conditioned silence. Zuko Ndlovu pours two glasses of single malt while Brigadier Mokoena and Councillor Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff watch you lay the bloodstained original pages of Tokomane ya Molato #409 and the auditor’s decrypted drive onto the glass table.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Logistics is about removing friction," Zuko says softly, looking out over the darkened city grid. "You proved more capable than Brigadier Mokoena’s entire regiment. Name your tariff."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: You strike the match yourself. As the original forensic annexures curl into ash, your suspension is wiped from the SAPS mainframe, Constable Nandi’s name is cleared with a quiet medical pension, and your newly registered consulting firm is awarded 20% of the Zululand Aqua-Logistics pipeline.

ending.ending_vigilante.p3: In the chaos, you breach the lead armoured command van, haul out two steel cases of Abasanta bearer Tjhelete e Letsohong, and pull Constable Nandi into your getaway car before the port sirens even spin up.

ending.ending_whistleblower.p1: At 04:00 AM, Colonel Piet van der Merwe’s loyal Hawks task force seals the steel blast doors of the Old Polokelo ya Nalane Kamore e ka Tlase. While Constable Nandi is smuggled onto a light aircraft bound for a witness-protection safe farm in the Drakensberg, you upload the decrypted Berth 14 audio and the audited Zululand Aqua-Logistics ledgers to every independent newsroom in the country.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p2: By sunrise, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice—ordering the execution of the municipal auditor and clearing the N2 weighbridge for Zuko’s chemical tankers—is playing on every taxi radio and morning news bulletin from Durban to Johannesburg.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p3: Outside City Hall, thousands of residents whose taps have been dry for months flood the streets, surrounding Councillor Ma-Sibi’s motorcade.

event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p1: Pula e futhumetseng ya lebopong e otla konkreiti e bonesitsweng ya Hangar 7. Lienjine tsa Rolls-Royce tsa Gulfstream ZS-900 di puruma ha basebetsi ba forklift ba ntse ba kenya mapolanka a ho qetela a ditokomane tsa bohlokwa le mekotla ya dipuisano ka har'a sefofane.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: Botlaseng ba ditepisi tsa sefofane ho eme baqapi ba bararo ba ho hapuwa ha eThekwini-Gold: Zuko Ndlovu a apere jase ya hae e hlwekileng, Councillor Ma-Sibi a tshwere pasepoto ya hae ya dipuisano, le Brigadier Mokoena a ikemiseditse ka sethunya sa hae se lebile ho phatlalla le tarmac e metsi.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Metsotso e mehlano ho fofeng, Warrant Officer," Zuko o hoeletsa ka hodima lerata la jet. "Iketsetse qeto ya hore na ke naha e jwang eo o tla tsoha ho yona hosane."

Malakabe a melomo ya dithunya a bonesa pula ha marumo a dithunya tsa othomathiki a phatloha jwalo ka marangrang a sekgo fenstereng ya hao e kapele.
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p2: Zuko le Brigadier Mokoena ba rometse babolai ba bona ba hirilweng ba tswang kantle ho porofense ho etsa bonnete ba hore ha o mohla o fihlang setsheng sa dipaki sa High Court.

Tanki e nngwe le e nngwe ya metsi ya masepala e neng e lefiswa ditoropong tse omeletseng tsa leboya, e ne e hlile e kgutlisetswa tseleng ya N3 ho ya Lot 44: Hydroponic Citrus Estate.

event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Nako ya hao e felile. Hore na o fihlile mona ka dipalo tsa matlotlo, direkoto tsa lentswe, kapa matla a seterateng, o na le monyetla o le mong feela wa ho bapala karete ya hao pele convoy e tloha ho ya tseleng ya N2.

event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: O wela fatshe tseleng ya ditepisi ya Mercury Arcade, o ntse o lwana ho hema. Haeba o sa tsitsise methapo ya hao hona jwale, o tla etsa phoso e kotsi.

event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: O ala maqephe a nang le madi a Docket #409 tafoleng ya hao tlas'a lebone la inverter. Dinomoro di qetella di utlwahala.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics" e lefisitse City Hall R400 million bakeng sa ho isa metsi a tshohanyetso metseng e omeletseng ya leboya. Empa di-log tsa GPS di bontsha hore ditankere tseo ha di a ka tsa ya metseng eo—di kgannetse ho tloha Pier 2 Cold Storage ho ya matlong a polokelo a indasteri kantle ho toropo, di felehetswa ke di-van tsa TRT tsa Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: Councillor Ma-Sibi ha a utswe tjhelete ya metsi feela. Ditankere tsa hae di tsamaisa dikhemikhale tse sebediswang bakeng sa di-lab tsa methamphetamine tsa Zuko Ndlovu.

event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Marshals a tsela a Bra Bheki a nkile ditsela ka diseke le disjambok, ha dipatrol van tsa SAPS di kgomaretse dikilomitara tse pedi ho tloha moo.

event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. Re a tseba hore Constable Nandi o o tliselitse dipampiri tsa Mandla Sithole. Ha ho motho City Hall ya batlang lebitla le leng. Diehisa tlhahlobo ya hao kajeno, mme tefo ya R800 ya consulting ya masepala e tla lahlelwa ka lebokoseng la hao la poso nakong ya hora e le nngwe."

event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Mamela hantle. Meropa ya dikhemikhale ya Zuko Ndlovu e laollwa Berth 14 bosiung bona, mme makoloi a TRT a Mokoena a se a eme weighbridge. Netefatsa hore o tshwere Decoded Tanker Ledger kapa Berth 14 Manifest pele bosiu bo bohareng bo fihla."

intro.pitch: Likhoeling tse ts'eletseng tse fetileng, Brigadier Titus Mokoena o ile a u qosa ka bohata 'me a pata beche ea hau ea Hawks. Bosiung bona, nakong ea kgaolo ea motlakase ea Stage 4 lebopong, molekane oa hau oa mehleng o khoptjoa ka folethong ea hau ea Mercury Arcade a tsoa mali ka lebaka la leqeba la lithunya—a nkile buka e nang le mali e kopanyang lithendara tsa literaka tsa metsi tsa City Hall tsa R400m ka kotloloho le mokhatlo oa lithethefatsi oa Abasanta.
intro.pitch_story2: Pshatlo ea maano ea ho fehla motlakase ea Eskom ho qobella lithendara tsa diesel tsa tšohanyetso, tse tšehelitsoeng ka lichelete ke bo-rakhoebo ba tšireletso le matona a bolotsana. Mofuputsi oa SIU Kagiso "Bra K" Molefe o tlameha ho kenella mekoting e tebileng ea merafo ea Johannesburg le matlong a majabajaba a Sandton pele marang-rang a putlama.
intro.pitch_story3: Litokelo tse sa ngolisoang tsa ho cheka litaemane botebong ba leoatle, thepa ea libetsa e tšelang meeli, le bahlabani ba likepe tsa poraefete ba hlatsoang chelete ea matla hore e be majoe a likhohlano tsa machaba lebopong la Atlantic le koahetsoeng ke moholi la Port Nolloth le Richtersveld.
intro.pitch_story4: Kopano ea moriti ea balaoli ba sepolesa sa provense, mekhatlo e kopaneng ea likhukhuni tsa Cape Flats, le bo-rakhoebo ba nalane ba Winelands ba hlometseng lebotho la tšireletso la poraefete ho laola moruo oa bosiu le likou tsa thomello. Detective ea khale ea Anti-Gang Unit Leila Hendricks o batlisisa ho tloha Camps Bay ho isa libakeng tsa veine tsa Stellenbosch.
intro.pitch_story5: Ho Putlama ho Feletseng ha Marang-rang a Motlakase a Boemo ba 8 ho pholletsa le liprovense tsohle tse robong. Sehlopha se Kopaneng sa Hawks se kopanya litsela tse 'ne tsa bohlokoa tsa meralo ea libaka ho hlasela seboka sa Sovereign Octagon Drakensberg pele demokrasi e felisoa ka ho sa feleng.

mission.classified_exhibits_header: Bopaki bo Sephiring le Lisebelisoa tsa Maraka o Motšo:
mission.faq_q1_body: Cycle ke Letsatsi le 1 Papaling (shift ea lihora tse 24). Ha ho na palo e behiloeng e kang matsatsi a 50 kapa a 100. Ho e-na le hoo, u matha khahlanong le Lioache tsa Litšokelo tse Tsoelang Pele (joaloka tlhaselo ea Brigadier Mokoena likarolong tse 6). Patlisiso e tloaelehileng e nka matsatsi a 3 ho isa ho a 6 bakeng sa Act 1 le a 4 ho isa ho a 8 bakeng sa Act 2.
mission.faq_q1_title: 1. "Cycle" ke eng hona ho na le tse kae?
mission.faq_q2_body: Hoseng ho hong le ho hong, u lahlela litaele tse 3 ho isa ho tse 5 KAOFELA bakeng sa toropo eohle ho latela Boikemisetso ba hau (80%+ = litaele tse 5, 40–79% = litaele tse 4, <40% = litaele tse 3). HA U lahlele litaele sebakeng se seng le se seng! U khetha liketso tse 3 ho isa ho tse 5 tsa bohlokoa lefatšeng lohle ho kenya matsapa a hau a letsatsi.
mission.faq_q2_title: 2. Ke fumana litaele tse kae? Na ke lahlela litaele sebakeng se seng le se seng?
mission.faq_q3_body:
Ho tobetsa Qetella Cycle ho phetha shift ea hau le ho fetela hoseng ho hlahlamang:
• Lioache tsa Litšokelo lia tsoela pele (+1 karolo lioacheng tse khubelu).
• Kgaolo ea motlakase ea potoloha (Stage 2 → 4 → 6 → 2).
• Molaetsa o Patiloeng oa Masa oa fihla ka litsela tse ncha tsa pale.
• U lahlela litaele tse ncha hosasane hoseng.
mission.faq_q3_title: 3. Ho etsahala'ng ha ke tobetsa "Qetella Cycle / Robala"?
mission.faq_q4_body: Tereing e ka tlase e bontša "X e Teng • Y e Sebelisitsoeng". Litaele tse sebelisitsoeng li fetoha bohlooho bo lefifi 'me li bontša letšoao la [E SEBELISITSOENG]. Litaele tse teng ke li-block tse khanyang tse nang le matheba a khauta kapa linomoro.
mission.faq_q4_title: 4. Ke tseba joang hore na ke litaele life tse sebelisitsoeng le tse teng?
mission.faq_q5_body: E! Haeba tlhaselo ea Brigadier Mokoena e fihla ho 6/6, foletho ea hau e ea hlaseloa 'me patlisiso e fella ka ho tšoaroa. Haeba mali a Constable Nandi a fihla ho 4/4 pele o mo tsitsisa, o shoa ka ho sa feleng folethong ea hau (-30% Boikemisetso). Haeba Boikemisetso ba hau bo fihla ho 0%, o qala Paranoia ea Blackout!
mission.faq_q5_title: 5. Na sebapali sa ka se ka shoa kapa sa baka Game Over?

pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: Ka nako ya bobedi hoseng, gridi ya masepala e shwa ka lerata le boima ho tloha seteisheneng sa motlakase Queen Street. Fene ya siling e emisa ho potoloha. Ka ntle ho difensetere tsa hao, pula ya lebopo e otla marulelo a tshepe a Mercury Arcade, e bonesitswe feela ke lesedi la jenereithara ya dizeli ya spaza shop ka thoko.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Desking ya hao ho na le botlolo ya cane spirits e setseng halofo le lengolo la ho emiswa le saennweng ke Brigadier Titus Mokoena dikgwedi tse tsheletseng tse fetileng.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Ebe ho utlwahala modumo—eseng ho buzzer ya tlase, empa ho otla ho hoholo ho meraro ho Trellidor ya hao ya tshepe hodimo ho fire escape. Pele o fihlella 9mm Parabellum tlas'a materese a hao, hopola hore na o ne o le mang pele Mokoena a pata mosebetsi wa hao:
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: O lokisa Z88 ya hao mme o hatela thoko ho monyako. Ka lesoba la monyako, lebone la tshohanyetso le benya hodimo ho jase ya SAPS e kolobitsweng.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: Ke Constable Nandi—rookie a le mong seteisheneng ya hanileng ho saena affidavit ya bohata ya Mokoena kgahlanong le wena. O tshwere dikgopo tsa hae tsa letsohong le letshehadi, madi a lefifi a tswang pakeng tsa menwana ya hae, a nkile docket e boima ya manila le smartphone e phatluhileng tlas'a letsoho la hae.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." o hema ka thata, mahlo a hae a shebile moriti wa litepisi. "Bula heke. Ka kopo. Divan tsa TRT tsa Mokoena di sa tswa feta tekesi rank. Haeba transponder ya radio ya ka e ntse e sebetsa, ba dikgato tse pedi ka morao ho nna."
pnode.scene_2_the_door.role: SAPS Sepolesa sa Terene e Potlakileng le Mmila o Moholo (Motho oa Hao oa Pele)
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: O hatella thaole e hlwekileng lehlakoreng la hae. 9mm hollow-point e mo hlotse dikgopo—e tebile hoo e tswang madi kamehla, e kotsi haholo ho rokwa sepetlele sa mmuso moo bangodi ba mapolesa ba ngolang mosebetsi o mong le o mong wa thunya.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: Nandi o o nea Docket #409 le smartphone e tletseng madi. "Re ile ra arabela bosholu ba Cash-in-Transit rampeng ya N2 boroa gare ho bosiu. Van ya G4S e phatlohile ka C4, Warrant. Empa ho ne ho se na dikhasete tsa tjhelete kahare."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: O metsa ka thata, a thothomela. "Ho ne ho na le mohlahlobi wa masepala ya shweleng a tlamehilwe ka diketane, le buka ena ya ditjhelete. Diranta tse dimilione tse nne tse makgolo ho dithendara tsa ditanka tsa metsi a tshepo tse fetisitsweng ka ofisi ya Councillor Ma-Sibi ho ya matlong a polokelo a boema-kepe a Zuko Ndlovu. Ha molekane wa ka a leka ho e ngola, Brigadier Mokoena o ile a fihla ka bakkie ya TRT e se nang matshwao... mme a mo thunya sefubeng."
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: Nandi o idibala hodima sofa ya hao ha lesedi la meso le qala ho hlaba ka fensetere. Kantle, ditekesi tsa pele di qala ho lla Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: O na le mathata a mabedi a potlakileng: leqeba la thunya la Nandi le tla bola nakong ya matsatsi a mane haeba o sa patale ngaka e sebetsang ka sephiri (R1,500), mme dihlopha tsa TRT tsa Brigadier Mokoena di ntse di hlahloba setereke sena block ka block.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Matsohong a hao ho na le bopaki bo kopanyang City Hall, SAPS Organized Crime, le Abasanta Cartel. Dice tsa hao tsa letsatsi le letsatsi di lokile tafoleng.

tutorial.step1.badge: KGATO 1 HO TSONA TSE 6 // BARA YA TLASE LE MOELETSI
tutorial.step1.bullet1: Tobetsa taele efe kapa efe e ka tlase ho e tšoara—Sekheo se seng le se seng sa Ketso se bontša kakaretso ea hau e fetotsoeng (Botala 6+, Boserolane 4–5, Khubelu 1–3).
tutorial.step1.bullet2: Ha o na bonnete ba hore na o etse eng ka mor'a moo? Latela "Moeletsi oa Leano" Karolong e ka Letsohong le Letšehali kapa u batle libeche tsa "★ Khothalelitsoe".
tutorial.step1.bullet3: Ha ditaele tsa hao li fela bakeng sa letsatsi, tobetsa "Qetella Potoloho / Robala →" ho fetela hoseng ho hlahlamang.
tutorial.step1.desc: Haufi le mafube a Cycle (Letsatsi) le leng le le leng, mofuputsi oa hau o phutha litaese tse 3 ho isa ho tse 5 tse nang le mahlakore a tšeletseng ho latela Boikemisetso ba hajoale (80–100% = litaese tse 5, 40–79% = litaese tse 4, <40% = litaese tse 3). Boikemisetso ke mamello ea hau ea kelello le ho tiea khahlanong le lefatše le ka tlaase la Durban.
tutorial.step1.title: Mohato oa 1: Litaese tsa Ketso tsa Letsatsi le Letsatsi & Boikemisetso
tutorial.step1.zone: Ditaele tsa Liketso tsa Letsatsi, Boiketlo le Moeletsi oa Leano
tutorial.step2.badge: KGATO 2 HO TSONA TSE 6 // DROPO YA KA HOSENG
tutorial.step2.bullet1: Phetho ea ho Diha = Sefahleho sa Taele + Phetoho ea Boemo + Bonase ea Kgato 6 + Lisebelisoa.
tutorial.step2.bullet2: 6 kapa ho feta (Botala — Katleho e Hloekileng): Tsamaisa Liwache tsa Lipatlisiso pele ka +2 kapa e fana ka Diranta tse ngata.
tutorial.step2.bullet3: 4 kapa 5 (Boserolane — Katleho e nang le Kotsi): E tsamaisa wache pele ka karolo ea +1 empa e lahleheloa ke Boiketlo bo bonyenyane.
tutorial.step2.bullet4: 1 ho isa ho 3 (Khubelu — Ho Hloleha / Phello e mpe): Ha ho tsoelopele, tahlehelo ea Boiketlo, ebile e eketsa Mofuthu oa Mapolesa.
tutorial.step2.desc: Tšoara kapa tobetsa taese ho tloha botlaaseng ba hau, ebe o tobetsa Sebaka sa Ketso ho node efe kapa efe ea 'mapa e sa notleloang. Liphetho tsa ho phutha li rarolloa ka mokhoa o tiileng: Boleng ba Taese + Phetoho ea Stat + Phetoho ea Lefifi la Stage 6 + Kotlo ea Sebaka se Mabifi. Maemo a bontšoa ka ho hlaka: 6+ Katleho e Hloekileng, 4–5 E Senyehile, 1–3 Ho Hloleha.
tutorial.step2.title: Mohato oa 2: Ho Abelana Litaese libakeng tsa Ketso
tutorial.step2.zone: Likheo tsa Liketso tsa Node le Liphetoho tsa Maemo
tutorial.step3.badge: KGATO 3 HO TSONA TSE 6 // MORUO LE MATLA A PHAHAMENG
tutorial.step3.bullet1: Lebenkele la Thepa e Ntšo (Bohong bo ka Holimo): Reka lisebelisoa tsa ka mehla ho Golden Dragon kapa Point Road (+1 WAYA, +1 SETERATA).
tutorial.step3.bullet2: Mehala ea Leano ea Mekha (1 ka Letsatsi): Fihlella +1/+2 Rep le mokha ho qala bokhoni ba mahala ba letsatsi le letsatsi.
tutorial.step3.bullet3: Pholiso ea Ntlo e Bolokehileng: Sebelisa Diranta ho Tokiso ea Mahlomola (+25% Boiketlo), Masene a Shebeen, Diesel (R300), le Kokoanyo ea Mapolesa (R200).
tutorial.step3.desc: Matla a Eskom a potoloha ho Stages 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 bosiung bo bong le bo bong. Nakong ea Lefifi la Stage 6, libaka tsa li-server tsa theknoloji e phahameng lia notleloa ntle le haeba u sebelisa R300 ho Diesel ea Jenereithara ea Backup, empa lits'ebetso tsa lekunutu Koung le Li-Estate li fumana Bonase ea +2 ea ho Phutha tlas'a sephiri sa lefifi.
tutorial.step3.title: Mohato oa 3: Lefifi le Potolohang (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step3.zone: Diranta (ZAR), Lebenkele la Lisebelisoa le Melemo ea Mekha
tutorial.step4.badge: KGATO 4 HO TSONA TSE 6 // LITŠHOSETSO LE PHETHO
tutorial.step4.bullet1: Ho Hlolwa / Ho Tšoaroa (Papali e Felile): Haeba tlhaselo ea Brigadier Mokoena e fihla ho 6/6, ntlo e bolokehileng ea hlaseloa 'me o ea tšoaroa.
tutorial.step4.bullet2: Tahlehelo ea Sebapali (Lolepera Nandi): Haeba ho tsoa mali ha Nandi ho fihla ho 4/4 pele o mo phekola, Nandi o shoa ruri ka tlung ea hau (-30% Boiketlo).
tutorial.step4.bullet3: Ho Senyeha ha Boiketlo (0% Boiketlo): Ho fihla ho 0% ho baka ho senyeha ha maikutlo ho jang Taele e 1 hoseng. Ho theola seriti sa mokha ho ya ho -2 ho baka tlhaselo ea lihlomo.
tutorial.step4.desc: Lioache tse potolohang tse arotsoeng li bala ho theoha ha likoluoa tse tlang (Lehloela la Brigadier Mokoena, Leqeba la Nandi, Lihlopha tsa Izinkabi) le ho latela katleho ea hau ea bofokisi (Tlhahlobo ea Docket #409, Ho Senya Mehala, Koloi ea Berth 14). Ha lioache tsa lipatlisiso li tlala, likhohlano tsa ho qetela tse matla lia buloa.
tutorial.step4.title: Mohato oa 4: Lioache tsa Tšokelo & Lipatlisiso
tutorial.step4.zone: Liwache tsa Tšokelo, Boiketlo le Qetello ea Sebapali
tutorial.step5.badge: KGATO 5 HO TSONA TSE 6 // BOHOLO BA KA HOLIMO LE MAPA
tutorial.step5.bullet1: Ho Kwalwa ha Kgato 6: Li-server tsa City Hall le Golden Dragon li tsoa inthaneteng nakong ea Kgato 6—ntle le ha o lefa R300 ea diesel.
tutorial.step5.bullet2: Bonase ea Kgato 6: Ho kena Pier 2 Cold Storage ho fumana Bonase ea +2 nakong ea Kgato 6 hobane mabone a boema-kepe a tima.
tutorial.step5.bullet3: Lithibelo tsa SAPS: Haeba Mofuthu o fihla ho 4+, litsela tsa toropo lia koaloa, li hloka tjotjo ea R200 kapa Taele e 1 ho tšela ntle le ha o na le SAPS Radio Scanner.
tutorial.step5.desc: Maemo a Phahameng a Mocheso oa Sepolesa kapa Litšokelo a baka litsela tse thibetsoeng tsa SAPS tse hlometseng lipakeng tsa likarolo. Ho li tšela ho chesa 1 Die kapa R200 ka tjotjo ea lino tse batang ntle le haeba u na le scanner ea SAPS e kopitsoang. Fumana Botumo bo Botle ba Sehlopha ho notlolla bokhoni ba maano ba 1/letsatsi joalo ka Grid Manipulation le Blue-Light Escorts.
tutorial.step5.title: Mohato oa 5: Litšitiso tsa Litsela le Melemo ea Lihlopha
tutorial.step5.zone: Kgaolo ea Motlakase le Lithibelo tsa Mapolesa (SAPS)
tutorial.step6.badge: KGATO 6 HO TSONA TSE 6 // LETŠOLO LE HO BAPALA HAPE
tutorial.step6.bullet1: Ho Hlola Ketso 1 le ho Kena ho Ketso 2: Fumana lintlha tse 2 tsa bohlokoa ho qala Berth 14 Finale, ebe o tobetsa "Tsoela pele ho Ketso 2: The Bluff Refinery →".
tutorial.step6.bullet2: Ho Hlola Ketso 2: Hlahloba pehelo ea phaephe ea Island View le tlhahlobo ea lik'hemik'hale ho qala Kahlolo ea Palamente.
tutorial.step6.bullet3: Papali e Ncha+ le Ngoliso ea Fixer: Kamora tlholo, sheba Boemo ba hau ba Fixer ho Registry ea eThekwini, bokella Libeche tse 6, 'me u qale Papali e Ncha+ ho boloka lisebelisoa tsohle + R1,000!
tutorial.step6.desc: Bua le batho ba sebetsang sebakeng seo le baetapele ba lihlopha sebakeng ka seng ho botsisisa lintlha, ho fana ka bopaki ba bofokisi, le ho kopa lisebelisoa tsa nako e le 'ngoe. Tobetsa 'B' kapa tlanya 'BOARD' neng kapa neng ho hlahloba letlapa la hau la khoele e khubelu la bolotsana, ho latela tsela ea chelete ho tloha City Hall ho ea Berth 14.
tutorial.step6.title: Mohato oa 6: Batho bao u Amanang le Bona, Bopaki le Letlapa la Khoele e Khubelu
tutorial.step6.zone: Ketso 1 → Ketso 2, Polokelo ea Liphetho le Papali e Ncha+
